protocol.switch_rule: Ground-truth phase_success triggers the next expert, for diagnosis only
protocol.chain_success_criterion: All three phases succeed, ending in original physical full pickup; centered grasp handoff alone does not certify centered final pickup
protocol.chain_centered_success_criterion: Independently observe 25 consecutive original stable-lift actions with XY<=15 mm, relative Z0–15 mm and downward tilt<=15 degrees anywhere in the chain; phase counters never reset this audit
protocol.actor_input: two RGB frames plus original 18 proprioceptive values
protocol.action_space: all five original direct torque/force commands
protocol.stochastic_semantics: Existing checkpoint predict: fresh Gaussian action sampling; no persistent rollout gSDE
protocol.pool_purpose: Trusted simulator reset states only; previous actions are history, never action targets

duration.pickup_commitment: Irreversible until true physical task termination

evaluation_reward_units: Raw physical task rewards; training multiplier is not applied
arrival_pool_usage: Verified provenance only; no arrival resets in this recipe
commit_probability_initialization: Inherited learned state-dependent logits; no reinitialization

actions.0: Continue approach for one fixed block

workers.reward: Sum gamma**j physical rewards for the entire block or terminal commitment

base_environment.shaping_formula: gamma * Phi(next) - Phi(previous); Phi=0 at every terminal state
